LeadFire · COMING SOON

Keep the connection after the show.

Turn conversations into connections.

LeadFire is our planned lead capture product for exhibitors and event teams. It is being designed to connect contact details with the context of each conversation: interests, notes and follow-up priorities. The goal is to help teams leave the show floor with organized opportunities and a clear next step.

Talk to us about LeadFire

THE PRODUCT DIRECTION

A busy show floor should create opportunities—not a stack of disconnected notes. We are shaping a more intentional path from an introduction to a useful follow-up.

01

Capture the context

A planned workflow for recording contact details and the interests discussed at your booth.

02

Organize the next step

Concept tools for adding notes and qualifying interest while the conversation is still fresh.

03

Support the handoff

A product direction centered on giving follow-up teams useful, organized information after the event.

This product overview describes our direction. It is not a promise of final features or a launch date.
